title: The Vegetable Root Discourses — Caigentan (English)
summary: A complete English reading of the Caigentan: 356 short entries on character, on getting through the world and on getting free of it, written by Hong Yingming of the Ming and prefaced in 1617 by Yu Kongjian, whose foreword is the only evidence about the author contemporary with him. The base text is the Harvard-Yenching copy of the Wanli 45 printing, collated character by character against a second transcription; the colophon sets out what was corrected and why.
